measured_canonical_raw.note: single venue (BINANCE USD-M perpetual), four fixed contracts: klines whose rows carry the six-field OHLCV shape only, that venue's funding, and its instrument definitions. No blockchain/UTXO dataset of any kind, no realized-cap or HODL-age band surface, and no BTC/USD (spot dollars) price source; every instrument is quoted and settled in USDT. The raw's own daily history begins 2022-01-01, about 1.18 four-year cycles, while the record multiplies by an age measured from 2009-01-03.

matrix.detail: Required data item 1: 'Universe: Bitcoin (BTC) spot on-chain ledger.' The raw holds one BINANCE USD-M perpetual contract on BTC (BTCUSDT, quote/settlement USDT) - a derivatives market on a centralised venue, not the Bitcoin spot ledger. No UTXO set, no ledger surface and no spot market exists in the tree (1633 entry names probed at depth <= 8 with 52 on-chain tokens: 0 hits).

Required data item 2 (DECISIVE): 'Data Source: Full archival Bitcoin node parsing UTXO creation dates, block heights, output values, and spend timestamps.' No UTXO/blockchain dataset exists anywhere in the raw tree; the store's own SCHEMA.md documents exactly 3 dataset families ['funding', 'instruments', 'klines (Binance USD-M perpetual futures, UTC)'], its INVENTORY.md states that no other store was found on the host, and no stored row shape carries an on-chain field. The realization prices themselves (P_creation) would additionally need BTC/USD quotes back to the genesis block (2009-01-03).

The record's instrument is Bitcoin in its native UTXO form ('Universe: Bitcoin (BTC) spot on-chain ledger'). Locally only a USDT-margined perpetual contract on BTC exists (BNBUSDT,BTCUSDT,ETHUSDT,SOLUSDT); every instrument in the export is a CryptoPerpetual quoted and settled in USDT, so the record's instrument is absent as registered even though a BTC price series is present.
The record's daily resolution exists locally: ['2022-01-01T00:00:00+00:00', '2026-09-15T00:00:00+00:00'] (open step [86400] seconds, open time exactly 00:00 UTC), 1718 bars.

Required data item 3: 'Price Reference: Daily BTC/USD volume-weighted spot index (e.g., Coin Metrics / Kaiko / CoinMarketCap) aligned with daily 00:00 UTC block timestamps.' No BTC/USD (dollar) series and no spot market exist: no entry name in the tree carries a spot/USD/provider token, every instrument is USDT-quoted (['USDT']), and the documented dataset families are ['funding', 'instruments', 'klines (Binance USD-M perpetual futures, UTC)']. UTC-day alignment is present in the klines (open_time_ms % 86400 == 0), so alignment is not the missing part - the registered source is.

Required data item 4 (DECISIVE): 'Derived Time Series: Daily aggregate RC_1w, RC_1y-2y, and elapsed calendar days from Bitcoin Genesis block.' RC_1w and RC_1y-2y are realized-value sums over UTXO age bands: with no UTXO set and no per-UTXO creation price there is neither numerator nor denominator, so the RHODL ratio itself cannot be formed. The missing prerequisite is the signal's own independent variable, not an auxiliary filter.

Required data item 5: 'Point-in-Time Requirement: Daily UTC closure snapshot of the confirmed UTXO set. Unconfirmed mempool transactions must be excluded.' No UTXO snapshot exists in any form, so the requirement has no substrate: nothing can be excluded from a set that was never captured.

RHODL_t = (RC_1w,t / RC_1y-2y,t) x (Date_t - 2009-01-03). Neither the ratio nor its market-age multiplier is constructible locally: the multiplier needs a history reaching back to 2009-01-03 while the raw's own daily history begins 2022-01-01T00:00:00+00:00 (1718 days, 1.176 four-year cycles), and the band aggregates do not exist at any date.

The registration's accumulation regime ('RHODL_t <= 350') has no series to read, so no episode count exists and the selector's sufficiency step (min_episodes_is) can never be evaluated. Recorded as not-computable rather than zero: the metric is absent, not empty.
The registration's distribution regime ('RHODL_t >= 15,000') is likewise not computable: no RHODL series - and therefore no historical median of one - exists locally.

Record falsification item 1 needs an accumulation signal (RHODL < 350) and multi-year forward returns versus buy-and-hold. The signal leg is absent; the buy-and-hold leg alone is derivable from local BTCUSDT 1d closes but cannot carry the test.
Record falsification item 2 requires the RHODL ratio's historical median; with no ratio series there is no median and no blow-off top to compare against.

Record falsification item 3 replaces the 1-week and 1-2 year bands with randomly selected age-band ratios. No age-band aggregates of any kind exist locally, so neither the registered bands nor their random replacements can be evaluated.

Record falsification item 4 requires an out-of-sample cycle showing the expanding divergence between RC_1w and RC_1y-2y. Both legs are unconstructible, and the local OOS slice (2025-10-01..2026-09-11) is not a cycle in the record's sense.

The record's evidence base and its published top/bottom zones are the 2011, 2013, 2015, 2017-18 and 2021 cycles. The raw's daily history begins 2022-01-01T00:00:00+00:00 - 1.176 four-year cycles - and cannot reach the record's historical sample.

Realized Value(u, t) = Amount(u) x P_creation(u), where P_creation(u) is the BTC/USD price on the day each UTXO was minted. An age-band aggregate over a UTXO set that still holds coins minted since the genesis block needs BTC/USD quotes from 2009-01-03 onward; the local series starts 2022-01-01T00:00:00+00:00 and is a USDT perpetual, so the creation-price leg is absent for every pre-2022 UTXO - i.e. for the 1y-2y band the signal depends on.

The buy-and-hold leg of the falsification battery is derivable from the local BTCUSDT 1d closes, but only on the local perpetual with USDT numeraire and only from 2022-01-01T00:00:00+00:00 - not on the record's spot-ledger sample.

The record states its execution assumptions are underspecified ('Exact order type, venue, leverage, hedging instrument, rebalance timing, holding period, transaction-cost model, and custody workflow are underspecified'). Registered here as read from the record; no default was invented in its place.

The raw's instrument export carries maker_fee/taker_fee/price_increment for the four local perpetuals plus that venue's funding rows, which is what the card's cost rail would consume. The record itself registers no cost convention, so this is a registration-side item only - nothing was priced because nothing traded.
